single_adapter_contract.location_rule: Exactly one translation seam at the existing F2 executor callback -> current-bound canonical EffectGate bridge boundary. Do not add another EffectGate, journal, executor, replay mechanism or completion authority.
single_adapter_contract.output_type: the EntityOSOutcomeUnknown class exported by the exact current-bound canonical effect-authority implementation
single_adapter_contract.translation_precondition: The F2 exception must already mean dispatch may have started. No pre-dispatch exception may be translated.
single_adapter_contract.identity_invariant: The adapter must not alter EffectRequestIdentity, request_sha256, effect_id, binding_id, invocation_id, tool_use_id, delegation_id, child_identity_sha256, user/session/generation, or the existing canonical PENDING row.
single_adapter_contract.replay_invariant: Translated exception must preserve replay_permitted=false. No same-turn or restart retry may cause a second executor call before explicit canonical reconciliation.
single_adapter_contract.authority_invariant: Translation changes exception vocabulary only. F2 remains non-authoritative; canonical EffectGate+EffectJournal remains the sole outcome authority.
negative_type_fence: ExecutorInterlockError before executor entry must not be translated
EntityOSEffectGateCallBridgeError before executor entry must not be translated
authority/path/blob/schema/API/request/call identity mismatch must not be translated
DENY/UNKNOWN preconditions must dispatch zero times
arbitrary RuntimeError/OSError before the F2 executor boundary must not be translated

Keep imports/binding explicit enough that a stale or wrong canonical exception class fails closed rather than silently widening the catch.
do_not: do not catch Exception and relabel it UNKNOWN
do not change effect_executor_interlock to depend directly on canonical EntityOS modules
do not let F2 write canonical journal terminal state itself
do not convert canonical FAILED rows after the fact
do not add a second retry ledger or executor
do not broaden PR430/canonical authority merely to make the adapter convenient

assert: no second dispatch on identical retry before reconciliation

required_no_real_effect_tests.setup: Fail authority/call/request identity or fail before executor callable is entered.

required_no_real_effect_tests.setup: Present a same-message generic RuntimeError or a wrong/stale canonical exception type.
